I.effect_boundary: Offline only; no provider writes or calls.

O: baseline report with commit and exact test output
F: Attempt to claim unobserved live success

X.timestamp_precision: date; midnight is a date marker, not execution time
X.objective: Reproduce the existing prototype baseline and identify concrete gaps without rebuilding it.
steps: Bind the current candidate commit and inspect AGENTS.md plus module interfaces and existing test inventory.
Run the scoped command in tests/README.md; inspect preview, duplicate suppression, ambiguous submission and profile drift behavior.
Compare results with the historical 91-test baseline and report changes with evidence.
acceptance: Scoped tests pass on the bound commit or every failure is classified with a reproducer.
Baseline report distinguishes mocked provider/model boundaries from live behavior.
X.rollback: Revert only owned changes; preserve journal and evidence. Reconcile any external effects; never automatically redial.
